purpose: Render a concise native instruction file for one bounded CSV quality profile step.
original_authoring_basis: Original composition for this pilot. Official client documentation informed filenames and Claude's local import syntax. No third-party procedure text was copied.

applicability_facets.task: profile one supplied CSV without modifying it
applicability_facets.project: one authorized input and one authorized output report

typed_input_concept.scan_row_cap: positive integer, bound to the run's resource budget

typed_output_concept: quality report with input identity, scan denominator, field counts, parse findings, exclusions and unknowns
effect_class: read supplied CSV and optionally write one authorized report; no source mutation, network or external service

requirements: Render all placeholders before installation; reject any remaining double-brace marker.
Resolve input, optional schema and output paths under the authorized workspace without traversal or symlink escape; output must differ from input.
Bind read, optional output write, row cap and disclosure level to typed run authority; this document grants none.
Encode inserted values as one-line Markdown text without control characters or import syntax; validate key columns against the actual header.
Review or mechanically qualify the rendered bytes and bind their digest to the selected source candidate before a native run.

positive_example: A four-row file has one blank field and a repeated declared key. A full scan reports four as denominator, one blank, and one repeated key without disclosing row values.
known_wrong_example: Only the first three rows of a much larger file are scanned, but the report claims a whole-file missing rate or includes raw email values. The method requires a capped-scan label and disclosure control.

closest_existing_material.difference: That item examines one text column for cleaning rules; this candidate profiles one CSV's shape and basic quality with a scan cap and disclosure rule.
That item defines future producer promises; this candidate reports observations from one supplied file.

discovery_phrasings_for_developer_search: Check this CSV for blank cells and duplicate keys without changing it.
Can you write a bounded quality report for this export and avoid exposing row values?
native_discovery_on_these_exact_bytes: Codex observed on unchanged copy in isolated no-model prompt input; other clients pending
limitations: This is a template, not a runnable finished assignment.
A client may read the instruction, but this template contains no CSV parser or executable tool.
